analyzed: yadā sarve pramucyante kāmāḥ ye sya hṛdi śritāḥ

original: atha martyo 'mṛto bhavaty atra brahma samaśnute || 6.14 ||
analyzed: atha martyaḥ mṛtaḥ bhavati atra brahma samaśnute
yadā sarve prabhidyante hṛdayasya iha granthayaḥ

original: atha martyo 'mṛto bhavaty etāvad dhy anuśāsanam || 6.15 ||
analyzed: atha martyaḥ mṛtaḥ bhavati etāvat hi anuśāsanam
śatam ca ekā ca hṛdayasya nāḍyaḥ
tayā ūrdhvam āyan amṛta tvam eti

original: taṃ svāc charīrāt pravṛhen muñjād iveṣīkāṃ dhairyeṇa |
analyzed: tam svāt śarīrāt pravṛhet muñjāt iva iṣīkām dhairyeṇa
vidyām etām yoga vidhim ca kṛtsnam
anyaḥ pi evam yaḥ vidadhyāt ātmam eva
